authors: S. Leurent, D. Serban, D. Volin
title: Six-loop Konishi anomalous dimension from the Y-system
claim: Six-loop planar Konishi anomalous dimension from a finite set of nonlinear integral equations (FiNLIE) equivalent to the Y-system of Gromov-Kazakov-Leurent-Volin; recursive procedure extendable to higher loops.
scheme: No regularization: not a DR (or any Feynman-graph) computation. Planar spectrum obtained from the integrable AdS5 x S5 worldsheet S-matrix (asymptotic Bethe ansatz with BES/BHL dressing phase) plus finite-size corrections. Y-system/TBA reformulated as FiNLIE.

assumed: all-loop integrability of planar N=4 SYM / AdS5 x S5 superstring
asymptotic Bethe ansatz with the BES/BHL dressing phase (exact worldsheet S-matrix)
identification of gauge-theory anomalous dimensions with string energies (AdS/CFT) in the planar limit

red_flags: no field-theory check at six loops exists in the surveyed literature
